backgrounds: A single bedroom set used for the entire episode: two stop-motion characters sit propped up in bed against a dark wooden headboard, framed in a static medium shot. The wall behind them is a plain dark brown/charcoal backdrop kept out of focus, and the bed is dressed with cream and grey pillows and a beige/cream blanket over the legs. A nightstand with a lit fabric-shade table lamp sits at frame-left; a second, dimmer nightstand with stacked items is faintly visible at frame-right edge. No other locations appear in the reel; the title/outro cards are plain black text screens rather than a physical set.
props: Warm-toned fabric table lamp on left nightstand (sole practical light source in shot)
Hardcover book held by the female character
Smartphone held by the male character, screen lit
Bed pillows (cream and grey-blue) stacked against headboard
Beige/cream blanket covering the characters' laps
Small items/clutter on the right-side nightstand (indistinct, background dressing)
Black-and-yellow 'NEW EPISODE DAILY' washi-tape graphic on title cards
lighting_notes: Low-key, warm practical lighting motivated entirely by the bedside lamp: an orange/amber glow washes the left side of the frame and both characters' faces, while the rest of the room falls into soft dark brown shadow. The phone screen adds a small secondary cool-white glow onto the male character's hand and face, contrasting with the warm lamp light. Overall mood is cozy, dim, nighttime bedroom lighting with strong warm/cool light-source contrast.
color_palette: mustard yellow and black (title card graphic accent)
visual_complexity_notes: The set is minimal and static: one unchanging camera angle on one bedroom scene for the whole episode, with only two characters and a handful of props (lamp, book, phone, pillows). This simplicity appears deliberate, keeping full visual focus on the two characters' exaggerated stop-motion facial expressions and the phone-screen interaction, rather than on environment or scene variety.
